dedupe_keys.name: counting vehicles cyclists and pedestrians at intersections equipped with traffic lights

description: Counting vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians at intersections equipped with traffic lights is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Counts of vehicles, cyclists and pedestrians at the majority of intersections equipped with traffic lights, as well as some intersections where the installation of lights was under consideration. For each of these intersections, all located in the 19 boroughs, the number of vehicles and pedestrians was recorded at different times of a typical day. Coverage: Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Its tags are Circulation, Counting, Traffic light, Traffic light, Intersection. It offers 13 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution (CC-BY) licence – Quebec. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
